prompts.prompt: Roughly how many Snowflake credits does Snowpipe charge per 1000 files loaded. Answer with the approximate number of credits.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/snowflake/SKILL.md - Snowpipe (Continuous Data Loading) section: Snowpipe is billed per file loaded, approximately 0.06 credits per 1000 files.

prompts.prompt: Compared with a standard Snowflake virtual warehouse node, how much more memory per node does a Snowpark-optimized warehouse provide. Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/snowflake/references/advanced-features.md - Snowpark section: Snowpark-optimized warehouses have 16x memory per node compared to standard warehouses.

prompts.prompt: After Snowflake Time Travel retention expires on a permanent table, how many additional days does Fail-Safe provide for data recovery. Answer with the exact number of days.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/snowflake/SKILL.md - Time Travel and Fail-Safe section: Fail-Safe is an additional 7-day recovery period after Time Travel expires, available only for permanent tables.
